purpose: Priority-34 acronym/noise curation: normalize Human Rights Watch and resolve treaty-body acronyms without materializing review processes or prose words.
identityRule: Acronyms representing stable organizations/institutions may resolve; treaty/review mechanisms and uppercase prose tokens are rejected or deferred.
